caveats.reading: rule label = assembly_or_evaluation (fresh rises, historical falls); but the historical average nearly stalls (-0.33 then -0.04 % pot), stays ~3.4x above the monolithic simultaneous run at the same iteration, and its class distance to A@400 does not shrink; the inner residual (<1% of the exploitability) is excluded as the cause. So the assembly explains the reversal, while the slow convergence of the factorized trunk itself remains unexplained (mixed).

rules.assembly_or_evaluation: historical average keeps improving (exploitability decreasing 50 -> 100 -> 150) while the fresh-solve evaluation stalls or rises
rules.reset_solve_approximation: both stall and the inner residual is large (total inner-residual contribution >= 25% of the fresh-solve exploitability in bb terms)
rules.decomposition_itself: both stall while the inner residual is small (< 25%)
rules.note: the 25% split is fixed here before results; mixed outcomes are reported as mixed
